subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should secops approve this grouped refresh of secret-bearing, publishing, scanning, and Codex action code after direct source verification?
rationale: Immutable pins reduce tag-movement risk, but they still replace executable third-party code at several privileged workflow boundaries, and repository policy requires direct Codex source inspection before approval.

options.title: Verify and merge together
options.body: Secops and a workflow owner verify all new SHAs, complete the sibling Codex contract check, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped update if exact-head checks are acceptable.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates into smaller PRs for independent approval and rollback.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge together
recommendation.body: Secops and a workflow owner verify all new SHAs, complete the sibling Codex contract check, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped update if exact-head checks are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly requires this team for several security-sensitive workflows in the patch.
